top_signals.title: TA Services acquires 2 Texas cross-border carriers, adds 133 trucks
top_signals.summary:
TA Services has acquired Carmen Pacheco Transportation and Interload Forwarding, adding 133 trucks and more than 550,000 square feet of warehousing along the U.S.-Mexico border.

The post TA Services acquires 2 Texas cross-border carriers, adds 133 trucks appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Cramer says these blue-chip stocks are among the best ways to invest in the AI boom
top_signals.summary: Jim Cramer said established tech giants with strong businesses and multiple ways to benefit from AI are some of the best places to invest in the boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
